representations.raw: For each legal public 48-row prefix collect four A PROBE prior-observation cues by role; keep four raw float cue values in physical role order. Add chosen-action onehot2 and public pivot fraction. Eight-dimensional input channel7 for composition zero.
representations.public_composition: Same eight-dimensional raw input, but channel7=sign(cue0)*sign(cue1)*sign(cue2)*sign(cue3), a DETERMINISTIC explicit public feature derived solely from lawful selected observations, not an imported teacher or independently discovered feature.
representations.corrupted_composition: Same raw cue values and same channel geometry but channel7 replaced with a within-pivot-group permuted four-A parity across OTHER FIT worlds, independent from target. Shuffle separately on FIT/VAL/DEV/OOD with pre-registered new salt, preserving time/cue marginal distributions; no hidden label or branch reward involved.
representations.GRU_input: Strong GRU64 receives full original 48x13 legal public sequence (not privileged oracle), evaluates chosen action at last step.
representations.equal_information_claim: RAW and COMPOSED use the same legally observed four cues; parity is deterministic from raw inputs, thus information-equivalent but not representationally equivalent. SHUFFLED controls are deliberately contaminated with irrelevant but distribution-preserving public features. GRU has more raw physical history and differing parameters/compute.

bootstrap.paired: COMPOSED minus stronger of RAW_MLP and GRU64 on same DEV worlds
